syllabus_extract: Basic concept of ECCM. Various methods of ECCM employed by Indian Naval aircraft viz. frequency agility PRF jittering etc
specific_objectives: 18.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to appraise the function of secondary radars in ASW operation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of ECCM diagrams in IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a radar system?
Define the term Electronic Counter-Counter Measures (ECCM).
Why is ECCM necessary in modern naval warfare?

topics: Definition and basic concept of ECCM
Role of ECCM in ASW operations
development.content:
Definition and basic concept of ECCM
Distinction between ECM and ECCM
Threat environment for naval aircraft
Role of ECCM in ASW operations
Importance of secondary radar integration

Frequency agility techniques
Pulse Repetition Frequency (PRF) jittering
Dwell time management
Implementation in Indian Naval aircraft
Effectiveness against modern threats

Secondary radar function in ASW
Data link integration with ECCM
Limitations of secondary radar systems
Coordination with primary radar
Operational scenarios for ASW

summary_questions: Explain how frequency agility disrupts enemy radar tracking.
Describe the role of PRF jittering in enhancing aircraft survivability.
How does the secondary radar support ASW operations alongside ECCM?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of ECCM discussed in this lesson will be applied in the next lesson plan regarding advanced radar systems.
